references.text: The same context regarding Israel's unique laws and righteous statutes that distinguish them from other nations.
Blessing linked to obedience to God's commands, which elevates Israel above all peoples.
The Lord's commandments give wisdom to the simple, reflecting the theme of God's law as a source of wisdom.
Fear of the Lord is the beginning of wisdom, and following His commands gives good understanding.
Fear of the Lord as the foundation of knowledge and wisdom, paralleling how God's laws grant wisdom.
The Lord grants wisdom; from His mouth come knowledge and understanding.
Peoples came from all over the earth to hear Solomon's wisdom, illustrating the nations' recognition of God's wisdom.
The Queen of Sheba testifies to Solomon's wisdom, showing how Gentiles acknowledged Israel's wisdom.
An encouragement to ask for wisdom from God, who gives generously to all without holding back.
An exhortation to walk wisely toward those outside, reflecting the witness to the nations.
Let your light shine before others so that they may praise your Father, paralleling how obedience testifies to the peoples.
